# Geethalayam

> Guru Smt. Geetha Saraswathy has taught Bharatanatyam in Velachery since 1971 — small classes, from first steps to arangetram.

Website: https://geethalayam.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99621 51320

## Contact
- Geethalayam, School of Bharatham · No. 7/6, Amudha Street, Dr. Seethapathy Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042 ·  · +91 99621 51320 · +91 73586 67606 · 044 2243 3055 · geetha.saraswathi@gmail.com

## Key facts
- Geethalayam founded 1971
- Abinaya Award 1964
- 4 levels, basics to arangetram

## Facilities
- Level I: basic steps
- Level II: alarippu, jathiswaram, sabdam & padams
- Salangai pooja
- Level III: varnam & thillana
- Arangetram
- Advanced level
- Weekday & weekend batches
- Small classes
- Online classes on Google Meet

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Geethalayam?
No. 7/6, Amudha Street, Dr. Seethapathy Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Geethalayam have?
Level I: basic steps, Level II: alarippu, jathiswaram, sabdam & padams, Salangai pooja, Level III: varnam & thillana, Arangetram, Advanced level, Weekday & weekend batches, Small classes, Online classes on Google Meet.

### What are the class timings?
Weekday batches run 4.30 to 6.30 pm by level; weekend classes run on Saturday and Sunday mornings.

### Can my child learn online?
Yes. Classes have also been held online over Google Meet.

### What do the levels cover?
Level I basic steps; Level II alarippu, jathiswaram, sabdam and padams with salangai pooja; Level III varnam and thillana leading to arangetram.

### How do I join Geethalayam?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99621 51320.
